rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical plate, and in context it can also mean one plateful or serving.

example.english: This dish is holding some vegetables.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 dip6 zong1 zyu6 di1 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a particular prepared food or cooked dish rather than the vessel it is served in.

example.jyutping: ni1 mei6 sung3 hou2 je5 mei6

rows.note: Use this for the crockery or tableware that is being washed after a meal.

example.english: We need to wash the dish after dinner.
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 gei3 dak1 sai2 wun2 dip6

rows.note: Use this technical term for an antenna shaped like a dish, including a satellite dish.

example.english: This building has installed a dish antenna.
example.traditional: 呢座大廈裝咗碟形天線。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 zong1 zo2 dip6 jing4 tin1 sin3
